chapter: Chicago clubs, entertainers and tent shows
title: After-hours sessions at the Apex Club and the Dreamland
summary: Musicians sat in at after-hours sessions at Jimmie Noone's Apex Club, and the Dreamland was sometimes loaded with players.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Now, in Chicago, was there a lot of sitting in, lot of jam sessions and after hours?
Oh, there was a lot of that.
And then where was this, where did this take place?
Well, there was a club there that we used to sit in up to the Apex Club, at times.
Yes. And they came by the Dreamland at times. At times the Dreamland was loaded with musicians, playing.
